entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin warrior and planeswalker with potent healing and protective powers, known as a noble hero and compassionate friend.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers of which Ajani is a member.

events.summary: Ajani devotes himself to protecting the weak and fighting those who seek to oppress others.
events.quote: Ajani devotes himself to protecting the weak and fighting against those who seek to oppress others.

events.summary: As a Gatewatch member, Ajani mentors fellow planeswalkers to help them master their gifts.
events.quote: As a member of the Gatewatch, Ajani often provides mentorship to his fellow Planeswalkers

relations.quote: As a member of the Gatewatch, Ajani often provides mentorship to his fellow Planeswalkers
